verses: Zamin o aasman ki her her cheez Allah Taalaa ki paki biyan kerti hai aur o hi ghalib hikmat wala hai
Aey eman walo! tum woh baat kiyon kehtay ho jo kertay nahi
Tum jo kertay nahi uss ka kehna Allah Taalaa ko sakht pasand hai
Be-shak Allah Taalaa unn logon say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss ki raah mein saff basta jihad kertay hain goya woh si seh pilaee hui emaarat hain

Aur (yaad kero) jabkay Musa ney apni qom say kaha aey meri qom kay logo! tum mujhay kiyon sata rahey ho halankay tumhen (bakhoobi) maloom hai kay mein tumhari janib Allah ka rasool hun pus jab woh log tairhay hi rahey to Allah ney unn kay dilon ko (aur) tairhaa ker diya, aur Allah Taalaa nafarman qom ko hidayat nahi deta

Aur jab Maryam kay betay Isa ney kaha aey (meri qom), bani israeel! mein tum sab ki taraf Allah ka rasool hun mujh say pehlay ki kitab Taurat ki mein tasdeeq kerney wala hun aur apney baad aaney walay aik rasool ki mein tumhen khushkhabri sunaney wala hun jin naam ahmed hai. Phir jab woh unn kay pass khulli daleelen laye to yeh kehney lagay, yeh to khulla jadoo hai
Uss shakhs say ziyadah zalim aur kaun hoga jo Allah per jhoot (iftra) bandhay halankay woh islam ki taraf bulaya jata hai aur Allah aisay zalimon ko hidayat nahi kerta
Woh chahatay hain kay Allah kay noor ko apney mun say bujha den aur Allah apney noor ko kamal tak phonchaney wala hai go kafir bura manen
O hi hai jiss ney apney rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja takay ussay aur tamam mazaahib per ghalib ker dey agarcheh mushrikeen khush hun
Aey eman walo! kiya mein tumhen woh tijarat batla doon jo tumhen dard naak azab say bacha ley?
Allah Taalaa per aur uss kay rasool per eman lao aur Allah ki raah mein apney maal aur apni janon say jihad kero. Yeh tumharay liye behtar hai agar tum mein ilm ho

Allah Taalaa tumharay gunah moaf farma dey ga aur tumhen unn jannaton mein phonchaye ga jin kay neechay nehren jari hun gi aur saaf suthray gharon mein jo jannat adan mein hun gay, yeh boht bari kaamyabi hai
Aur tumhen aik doosri (nemat) bhi dey ga jissay tum chahatay ho woh Allah ki madad aur jald fatah yabi hai, eman walon ko khushkhabri dey do

Aey eman walo! tum Allah Taalaa kay madadgar bann jao. Jiss tarah hazrat Maryam kay betay hazrat Isa ney hawariyon say farmaya kay kaun hai jo Allah ki raah mein mera madadgar banay? Hawariyon ney kaha hum Allah ki raah mein madadgar hain, pus bani israeel mein say aik jamat to eman laee aur aik jamat ney kufur kiya to hum ney mominon ki unn kay dushmanon kay muqabla mein madad ki pus woh ghalib aa gaye
